label: For "Regulatory Quality Measure Gap Detection": Identify missing documentation, measure evidence, workflow steps and data fields needed to satisfy selected quality requirements, with a requirement-to-evidence map that cites its sources and rule versions. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Scoring answers without checking citations.
